name: Zynaps: controldata
summary: The controls, the key names, the life marks, the event table and the level script's state.

labels.name: FireHeld
labels.comment: Passes fire has been held, 0 released (ReadControls $A725)

labels.name: FireChanged
labels.comment: $FF when fire was pressed or released since the last read ($A73C)

labels.name: ControlBits
labels.comment: Bit 0 right, 1 left, 2 down, 3 up ($A742)

labels.name: JoystickFlags
labels.comment: Bit 0 Kempston, bit 1 Sinclair rather than cursor

labels.name: KeyTable
labels.comment: 5 keys (fire up down left right) as port high byte and bit mask; P L SS A S by default

labels.name: KeyScanRows
labels.comment: The half-rows WaitKeyPress scans: $FE $FD $FB $DF $BF $7F

labels.name: KeyNames
labels.comment: The 40 key names in the order of the half-rows $FEFE..$7FFE; 0-3 = messages 9-12 (CS SS SP EN)

labels.name: LifeSteps
labels.comment: The attribute steps between the life marks (DrawLives $A4EF reads 6 bytes: the 6th is EventRequests, unused)

labels.name: EventRequests
labels.comment: A bit per job asked for (bit 7 first; EventDispatch $AC07)

labels.name: EventMask
labels.comment: The enabled jobs ($FF from the play loop's start)

labels.name: EventHandlers
labels.comment: The 8 job routines, bit 7 first

labels.name: ScriptState
labels.comment: The level script's state (35 bytes, $AD56 from the player record, $AED2 back)

labels.name: ScriptPC
labels.comment: the step being waited for (word)

labels.name: PlayFlags
labels.comment: bit 5 the scroll on, bit 7 the stars shown

labels.name: ScrollCount
labels.comment: word, +1 per scroll step (the level's start value from LevelTable)

labels.name: ScriptNumber
labels.comment: the scenery script

labels.name: ScriptLevelBias
labels.comment: added to WeaponRating ($9B9B)

labels.name: ScriptStackPtr
labels.comment: word: the script's call stack ($81F6 at the start, two bytes a call)

labels.name: ScriptWaitCount
labels.comment: the frames waited for the current step

labels.name: ScriptFlags
labels.comment: the flags of the last counter op (the conditions test them)

labels.name: ScrollRestart
labels.comment: $FF (op 1): start the scroll again at phase 4 (ScrollControl $A9A8)

labels.name: ScriptCounter
labels.comment: the word every script loops on (ops 7 and 9)

labels.name: ScriptCallStack
labels.comment: the call stack, 16 bytes below $81F6 (no script calls)

labels.name: ScriptStateInit
labels.comment: Copied to the record's +$15-+$19 at a level's start: the stack pointer $81F6, wait 0, flags 0, restart 0

labels.name: ScriptCommands
labels.comment: The level script ops 0-17 (JumpTable from WaveScriptStep $AD86)

labels.name: ScriptConditions
labels.comment: The 7 jump conditions on ScriptFlags: always, Z, NZ, C, NC, P, M ($AE00)
